name: ZCA_MASS_UPD_REQ_DETAILS
description: The ZCA_MASS_UPD_REQ_DETAILS table stores the request details of mass update request per object. The ZCA_MASS_UPD_REQ_DETAILS table stores denormalized information from MKT_IMP_OBJECTS, ZCA_EXP_JOBS, MKT_IMP_JOBS and REQUEST_HISTORY tables .

columns.name: REQUEST_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the request details . Primary key

columns.name: MASS_UPD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to MASS_UPD_REQUEST_ID in ZCA_MASS_UPD_REQUEST

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: View object name. Foreign key to OBJECT_VO in ZCA_OBJECTS

columns.name: EXPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Export batch id of the file export process. Foreign Key to SYSTASK_ID in MKT_CM_SYSTASKS

columns.name: IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import batch id of the file import process. Foreign key to SYSTASK_ID in MKT_CM_SYSTASKS

columns.name: EXPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Export job id of the file export process. Foreign key to EXPORT_JOB_ID in ZCA_EXP_JOBS

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Import job id of the file import process. Foreign key to IMPORT_JOB_ID in MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UCM_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: UCM ID of the exported file

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
